incident-bot: INCIDENT ⚠️ Lyric Corp (vpc-lyric-prod) — elevated model errors + latency. Error rate 15% -> 60% across dedicated pool shard-7. Paging oncall.
ryan_oncall: on it. peeling metrics now — can someone post the KVA/cache misses link?
meera_sre: https://grafana.redwood/c/lyric/overview -> mem pressure + OOMs on shard-7, eviction storms started ~02:12 UTC. Also seeing RPC timeouts to kv-store.
sam_ml: error payloads look like attention size mismatch on small-2 quant variant when sequence >1024. fallback path tries to hot-swap to small-1 but failed due to cache miss thrash.
ryan_oncall: ok — priority: stop customer impact, stabilize tail latency. Options: 1) pin Lyric tenant to known-safe model variant (small-1-quant) 2) route Lyric traffic to hosted fallback (non-VPC) 3) increase mem on shard-7 (lifting is slower). Thoughts?
julia_am: customer is on a transactional SLA. they will want a clear ETA and temporary mitigation. prefer option 1 + customer note. i can draft message.
emily_se: agree with 1 + mirror to hosted fallback as warm backup. we should also enable verbose logs for Lyric for the next 30m.
sam_ml: I can trigger a tenant override. syntax: `POST /v1/admin/tenants/lyric/override` payload: `{ "model": "redwood/small-1-quant", "reason": "prod-degrade-2026-03-17", "ttl_sec": 3600 }` — will it auto-warm kv cache?
meera_sre: override accepted path won't warm KV automatically. suggest we also pre-populate prefix cache for top endpoints. I can run a synthetic warmup job after override.
ryan_oncall: go for override + warmup. sam, can you apply? i'll coordinate warmup and route if needed.
sam_ml: applying override now.
deploy-bot: CONFIG CHANGE: tenant.override.lyric -> model=redwood/small-1-quant, ttl=3600, actor=sam_ml, change_id=chg-4823456789-1
sam_ml: override applied ✅
meera_sre: starting warmup script: `python tools/warm_cache.py --tenant lyric --endpoints /chat,/generate --workers 6`
meera_sre: warmup running, evictions dropping. observing 2xx rising and p50 latency improving.
ryan_oncall: monitoring. Julia — can you send a short update to Lyric ops: brief impact, mitigation (pinned to safe variant), ETA for full restore?
julia_am: drafting now: "We're seeing elevated errors; we've pinned your VPC traffic to a safe model variant and are running cache warmups. Minimal functionality restored; we'll follow up with timeline within 30m." will send in 2.
emily_se: also toggled request-logging for lyric: `admin toggle-logging --tenant lyric --level verbose --duration 30m`
deploy-bot: LOGGING: lyric verbose logging enabled by emily_se for 30m
ryan_oncall: metrics look stable — error rate down to 3%, p99 latency heading down. keeping this open until handoff.
julia_am: message sent to customer (ops@lyric): "Mitigation in place; we pinned to a safe variant and are running warmups. Expecting normal behavior within 15-30m. Contact me for any SLA concerns." cc: account exec.
meera_sre: note to runbook: mark shard-7 as suspect for hardware flakiness. creating incident ticket and scheduling follow-up postmortem.
ryan_oncall: i'm handing to daytime oncall @meera_sre in 25m. if anything regresses, @sam_ml + @julia_am please escalate.
sam_ml: copying configs to incident artifact: s3://redwood-incidents/4823456789/override.json
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Mitigation applied — customer pinned to safe model variant, warmup in progress, monitoring. Severity reduced.
